body:
Depends on "Strategy Features tab: read-only list".

- A form with title, the shared Markdown `editor` (its own textarea id), a state `<select>` (`proposed|planned|active|complete|canceled`) and a milestone `<select>` with "(none)".
- Add model fields for the draft, a saving flag and an error. Save sends `POST /features` with a `request` id, or `PATCH /features/{id}` with only the changed fields. Show errors (`E7001`, `E7023`).
- Tests: the request bodies for create and for edit with only changed fields, plus a create/edit step in the JS flow. Update the README.

Pieces 2–4 of the Features tab all edit `features.gleam` and `update`, so run them one after another rather than in parallel.
title: Strategy Features tab: create and edit
